items.label: EXA Express
items.name: EXA Express
items.description: A prime asset in our transatlantic portfolio. We are the sole owner of the entire system, and it's the fastest route between New York and London: sub-60ms round trip. Landing at Halifax, Cork and Burnham-on-Sea, with onward reach into New York and across Europe.

items.label: AEC-1
items.name: AEC-1
items.description: One of our owned transatlantic routes, linking the US East Coast directly to Ireland. Part of the network we now own end to end, duct to core, with no intermediate carrier risk between landing stations.

items.label: EXA North & South
items.name: EXA North & South
items.description: Our first wholly owned transatlantic systems. While more established, they remain reliable and resilient, upgraded in 2025 with FLEX technology and fully operational and supported for the long term. These systems represent EXA Infrastructure's cost-effective, protected transatlantic connectivity offering.
items.countries: United States, Canada, Ireland, United Kingdom

items.label: AEC-2 (Havfrue)
items.name: AEC-2 (Havfrue)
items.description: The only system serving the Northern corridor today. We are the only operator enabling access to all three EU cable landing stations, Ireland, Denmark and Norway. Following the Aqua Comms acquisition, EXA Infrastructure has a unique branch landing in Lecanvey, Ireland, with a protected and fully diverse route to Dublin.

items.label: AEC-3 (Amitié)
items.name: AEC-3 (Amitié)
items.description: Links the UK and France with the United States via the central transatlantic corridor, offering optimal connectivity between Central Europe and the New York region.

items.label: Dunant
items.name: Dunant
items.description: The first cable system to land in France since 2003, with direct interconnection from the US to FLAP cities.
